definitions.explanation: The branch of a country's military that conducts operations on land.

examples.japanese: {陸軍|りくぐん}に{入隊|にゅうたい}した。
その{国|くに}は{陸軍|りくぐん}の{兵力|へいりょく}を{増強|ぞうきょう}した。
{第二次世界大戦|だいにじせかいたいせん}では、{日本|にほん}の{陸軍|りくぐん}と{海軍|かいぐん}が{別々|べつべつ}に{作戦|さくせん}を{立|た}てていた。
examples.english: During World War II, the Japanese army and navy planned operations separately.

notes: One of the three main branches of the military alongside {海軍|かいぐん} (navy) and {空軍|くうぐん} (air force). In modern Japan, the equivalent is {陸上自衛隊|りくじょうじえいたい} (Ground Self-Defense Force), since Japan's postwar constitution prohibits maintaining traditional armed forces. The term {陸軍|りくぐん} is still used when referring to other countries' armies or to the historical Imperial Japanese Army ({大日本帝国陸軍|だいにっぽんていこくりくぐん}).
